review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the repeated patterns. These were the tensor-induction ladders (`linearMap_ext_cancel`, `distribHom_eq_distribLin`, `bijective_map_id`), the function-equality-then-bijective idiom (`distribHom_bijective`, `bijective_map_id`), and the symmetric `inclM_apply` and `inclE_apply`. I judged these routine, short, or not worth a shared lemma. The one non-trivial repetition I found is in `solution`: the chain from `hres` to "maps to 0 in the residue field" is written out twice. It sits inside a single theorem, not across two separate proofs, so the finding is modest. I did not compile the proposed rewrite.

findings.problem: The argument "x : O with algebraMap O (ZMod p) x = 0 ⟹ valuation of its image < 1 (via hres and valuation_lt_one_iff) ⟹ it lies in maximalIdeal P ⟹ it maps to 0 in ResidueField P (via ResidueField.algebraMap_eq and residue_eq_zero_iff)" is written out twice. First it is done for x = p, in hpm and hp0 (lines 330-337). Then it is done for x - c.val, in hx, hxm and the inner `this` of h1 (lines 346-354). Each copy repeats the same valuation_lt_one_iff, hres, algebraMap_eq and residue_eq_zero_iff rewrites, with different casts.
findings.proposed_change:
Prove one local fact first, placed after instOk and the IsScalarTower O P _ instance:

have key : ∀ x : O, algebraMap O (ZMod p) x = 0 → algebraMap O (IsLocalRing.ResidueField P) x = 0 := by
  intro x hx
  have hm : algebraMap O P x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal P := by
    rw [ValuationSubring.valuation_lt_one_iff]; exact (hres x).mp hx
  change algebraMap P (IsLocalRing.ResidueField P) (algebraMap O P x) = 0
  rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]; exact hm

Then hp0 becomes:
have hp0 : ((p : ℕ) : IsLocalRing.ResidueField P) = 0 := by
  have h := key (p : O) (by rw [map_natCast, ZMod.natCast_self])
  rwa [map_natCast] at h
and hpm is dropped.

In the scalar-tower block, hxm and the inner `this` are replaced by:
have := key _ hx
rw [map_sub, map_natCast, sub_eq_zero] at this
exact this

The `change` line relies on instOk being defined by `.comp`. That is true by definition, since the tower instance on line 328 is proved by `fun _ => rfl`.
findings.benefit: The valuation-to-residue-field step is stated and proved once. The characteristic-p fact and the scalar-tower fact become short consequences of one statement. This removes about ten lines and the intermediate hpm and hxm facts. A reader sees that both facts come from the same "maximal ideal ∩ O is the kernel of O → ZMod p" property, and any change to how the residue field algebra is built needs updating in one place.
